definitions.explanation: A suffix attached to numbers to indicate the ordinal period or class session in a school day. For example, 1時間目 means 'first period.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{時間目|じかんめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧だ。
⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{時間目|じかんめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: I was late for the third-period class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧{時間目|じかんめ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Today there are classes up to sixth period, so I'll be home late.

notes:
A suffix attached to numbers to indicate ordinal class periods in a school day. Japanese schools typically have 5-6 periods (⟦{時限|じげん}→時限：13098_jigen⟧) per day.

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{時間目|じかんめ}: first period
- ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{時間目|じかんめ}: second period
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{時間目|じかんめ}: third period
- {何|なん}{時間目|じかんめ}: which period?

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{時間目|じかんめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧だ: first period is Japanese language
- ⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧{時間目|じかんめ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there are classes up to sixth period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時間目|じかんめ}: used in elementary through high school for class periods
- ⟦{時限|じげん}→時限：13098_jigen⟧: also means "period" (more formal; used in university timetables)
- {限目|げんめ}: abbreviated form of {時限目|じげんめ}, e.g., ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{限目|げんめ} (first period, college usage)
